text:
52세 여성 severe community-acquired pneumonia로 ICU 입원함.

BP 102/64 mmHg.  
HR 112 bpm.  
RR 28 breaths/min.  
BT 38.5°C.  
SpO2 85% (room air).

Severe dyspnea 호소함.  

Levofloxacin 750 mg IV q12h 적용함.

High-flow nasal cannula 60 L/min, FiO2 0.6 유지함.

Ventilator 사용 중.  

Clinical status drowsy 확인됨.
